questions.question: What was Microsoft's total revenue in fiscal year 2026?
questions.reference: Microsoft's total revenue for fiscal year 2026 (ended June 30, 2026) was $331,839 million (about $331.8 billion).

questions.question: What was Microsoft's net income in fiscal year 2026?
questions.reference: Microsoft's net income for fiscal year 2026 was $133,749 million (about $133.7 billion).

questions.question: What were Microsoft's total liabilities and stockholders' equity at June 30, 2026?
questions.reference: At June 30, 2026 Microsoft had total liabilities of $315,989 million (about $316.0 billion) and stockholders' equity of $442,387 million (about $442.4 billion).

questions.question: What are Microsoft's reportable segments?
questions.reference: Microsoft reports three segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing.
questions.evidence: report our financial performance using three segments

questions.question: How many people did Microsoft employ at the end of fiscal 2026?
questions.reference: As of June 30, 2026 Microsoft employed approximately 223,000 people full time: 121,000 in the U.S. and 102,000 internationally.

questions.question: How much stock did Microsoft buy back in fiscal 2026, and how much of its repurchase authorization remains?
questions.reference: In fiscal 2026 Microsoft repurchased 36 million shares for $16.7 billion under its share repurchase program. As of June 30, 2026, $40.6 billion remained of the $60 billion program.
questions.evidence: $40.6 billion remained of our $60 billion share repurchase program

questions.question: How much did Microsoft declare in dividends in fiscal 2026 compared with fiscal 2025?
questions.reference: Microsoft's Board declared dividends totaling $27.0 billion in fiscal 2026, up from $24.7 billion in fiscal 2025.
questions.evidence: declared dividends totaling $27.0 billion and $24.7 billion

questions.question: How did Microsoft Cloud revenue perform in fiscal 2026?
questions.reference: Microsoft Cloud revenue increased 27% to $214.4 billion in fiscal 2026.
questions.evidence: Microsoft Cloud revenue increased 27% to $214.4 billion

questions.question: How many Xbox consoles did Microsoft sell in Brazil in fiscal 2026?
questions.reference: The 10-K does not disclose Xbox console unit sales by country, so this cannot be answered from the filing.

questions.question: What revenue does Microsoft forecast for fiscal year 2030?
questions.reference: The 10-K does not give a revenue forecast for fiscal year 2030, so this cannot be answered from the filing.

questions.question: What were Coca-Cola's net operating revenues in 2025?
questions.reference: Coca-Cola's net operating revenues for 2025 were $47,941 million (about $47.9 billion).

questions.question: What was Coca-Cola's net income attributable to shareowners in 2025?
questions.reference: Net income attributable to shareowners of The Coca-Cola Company was $13,107 million (about $13.1 billion) in 2025.

questions.question: What were Coca-Cola's total assets and total liabilities at December 31, 2025?
questions.reference: At December 31, 2025 Coca-Cola had total assets of $104,816 million (about $104.8 billion) and total liabilities of $70,541 million (about $70.5 billion; the balance sheet has no total-liabilities line, so this is total assets minus total equity of $34,275 million).

questions.question: What are Coca-Cola's operating segments?
questions.reference: Coca-Cola's operating segments are EMEA, Latin America, North America, Asia Pacific and Bottling Investments; its operating structure also includes Corporate.
questions.evidence: Our operating structure includes the following operating segments

questions.question: How large is Coca-Cola's potential exposure in its tax dispute with the IRS?
questions.reference: Coca-Cola estimates the potential aggregate remaining incremental tax and interest liability for tax years 2010 through 2025 could be approximately $14 billion as of December 31, 2025, with interest continuing to accrue until paid.
questions.evidence: potential aggregate remaining incremental tax and interest liability

questions.question: What are Coca-Cola's credit ratings?
questions.reference: As of December 31, 2025, Coca-Cola's long-term debt was rated A+ by Standard & Poor's and A1 by Moody's, and its commercial paper program was rated A-1 by Standard & Poor's and P-1 by Moody's.
questions.evidence: Our commercial paper program was rated

questions.question: How much unused backup credit does Coca-Cola have?
questions.reference: Coca-Cola had $6.2 billion in unused backup lines of credit for general corporate purposes as of December 31, 2025, expiring at various times through 2030.
questions.evidence: $6.2 billion in unused backup lines of credit

questions.question: What happened to Coca-Cola's Global Ventures segment?
questions.reference: In 2025 Coca-Cola sunset its Global Ventures operating segment to simplify its operating structure. Costa (excluding ready-to-drink), innocent and doğadan moved into the EMEA segment, while Costa ready-to-drink and the Monster fees are now reported within the geographic operating segments.
questions.evidence: we sunset our Global Ventures operating segment

questions.question: What dividend per share will Coca-Cola pay in 2028?
questions.reference: The 10-K does not state a 2028 dividend per share, so this cannot be answered from the filing.

questions.question: What is the personal net worth of Coca-Cola's CEO?
questions.reference: The 10-K does not disclose the CEO's personal net worth, so this cannot be answered from the filing.

questions.question: What was Tesla's total revenue in 2025 and how did it change from 2024?
questions.reference: Tesla's total revenue was $94,827 million (about $94.8 billion) in 2025, down 3% from $97,690 million in 2024.

questions.question: What was Tesla's net income in 2025?
questions.reference: Tesla's net income for 2025 was $3,794 million (about $3.8 billion).

questions.question: What were Tesla's total liabilities and stockholders' equity at December 31, 2025?
questions.reference: At December 31, 2025 Tesla had total liabilities of $54,941 million (about $54.9 billion) and stockholders' equity of $82,137 million (about $82.1 billion).

questions.question: What are Tesla's reportable segments?
questions.reference: Tesla has two reportable segments: automotive, and energy generation and storage.
questions.evidence: We operate as two reportable segments

questions.question: What was Tesla's liquidity position at the end of 2025?
questions.reference: Tesla ended 2025 with $44.06 billion in cash and cash equivalents and investments, up $7.50 billion from the end of 2024. Operating cash flow was $14.75 billion and capital expenditures were $8.53 billion in 2025.
questions.evidence: We ended 2025 with $44.06 billion in cash and cash equivalents and investments

questions.question: What key-person risk does Tesla disclose?
questions.reference: Tesla says it is highly dependent on the services of Elon Musk, its CEO (Technoking of Tesla), who does not devote his full time and attention to Tesla.
questions.evidence: We are highly dependent on the services of Elon Musk

questions.question: How does Tesla earn revenue from regulatory credits?
questions.reference: Tesla earns tradable credits under various regulations through its automotive business and sells them to other regulated entities, which use them to meet emission standards. The sales are recorded as automotive regulatory credits revenue. Government actions such as the OBBBA have restricted some of these credit programs.
questions.evidence: We earn tradable credits in the operation of our automotive business

questions.question: How did Tesla's energy generation and storage segment grow in 2025?
questions.reference: Energy generation and storage segment revenue was $12,771 million in 2025, up 27% from $10,086 million in 2024.
questions.evidence: Energy generation and storage segment revenue 12,771

questions.question: How many vehicles will Tesla deliver in 2028?
questions.reference: The 10-K does not forecast 2028 vehicle deliveries, so this cannot be answered from the filing.

questions.question: What credit rating does Fitch assign to Tesla?
questions.reference: The 10-K does not mention a Fitch credit rating for Tesla, so this cannot be answered from the filing.
